monthly_fit_as_of: Last observed quote session before the calendar month, including the first partial evaluation month
calibration_policy: Latest 60 signal dates with labels already available at fit-as-of
training_policy: Latest 252 or 504 signal dates strictly before calibration, with all training labels available before calibration starts
fixed_controls: One frozen copy of each window's first monthly model, with identical anchor information and hyperparameters
past_evaluation_labels: Earlier evaluated months may enter later fitting only after their outcomes have become available; old predictions are never recomputed
common_reference: Monthly known calibration-period class prevalence, identical across training-window sizes
evaluation_role: Previously inspected historical dates: retrospective development replay, not prospective validation
